items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 64:1
items.html: The Nukva dePardashka is the aspect of Malchut — namely, the corona of the Yesod of the NHY of Atik that are clothed in Arich Anpin, as written above in Answer 35. And see Or Pnimi, Page 404, s.v. 'Correction 3.' (Page 336, Item 91).
